bilingualCoverageRationale.de: Der ganze DE/EN-Profilkörper verlangt korrektes Einsetzen mit Einheiten, begründete lineare/quadratische Skalierung, inverse Verhältnisargumente, Skalarität und Bezugssystemabhängigkeit. Beide vollständigen Briefs sind richtig lösbar:50kJ/50kJ sowie2,5J im Zug und40J/10J am Boden. Die neue a646-Voraussetzung passt zur variablengetreuen Auswertung; der vorhandene Bewegungs-Owner bleibt erhalten. Es wird keine neue globale Vollständigkeit aller Prerequisites behauptet.
bilingualCoverageRationale.en: The complete bilingual profile requires consistent substitution and units, justified linear/quadratic scaling, inverse ratios, scalar character and reference-frame dependence. Both whole briefs are sound. The new substitution prerequisite supports numerical evaluation without replacing the physical interpretation.

ownFreshIndependentTransferAndCounterexa.task: Use m=0.75kg at signed velocities+8 and−8m/s; compare m=3kg at4m/s, then view the first two motions from a frame moving+3m/s. Explain equal energy and frame dependence.
ownFreshIndependentTransferAndCounterexa.solution: All three original energies are24J. Equal energy fixes mv², not mass or speed separately. In the moving frame,+8→+5m/s gives75/8J=9.375J, while−8→−11m/s gives363/8J=45.375J. Reversing sign in one frame preserves energy; changing frame need not.
ownFreshIndependentTransferAndCounterexa.counterexample: Equal energy does not imply equal speed; a signed negative velocity does not create negative kinetic energy.

bilingualCoverageRationale.de: Alle Pflichtblöcke und beide Briefs unterscheiden Ortsänderung über ein Intervall, lokale Tangentensteigung und deren Einheiten/Vorzeichen. Der Pflichtblock verwirft ausdrücklich das unbegründete Mittel der Randgeschwindigkeiten; die knappen Briefs ersetzen diesen Pflichtblock nicht. Graphauflösung begrenzt die lokale Schätzung. ae201 und b1dcc passen als unmittelbare fachliche Operationen, ohne die Ableitungsregeln9f2 als zusätzliche Pflicht einzuführen.
bilingualCoverageRationale.en: All required blocks and both briefs distinguish interval displacement rate from local tangent slope with sign and units. The required endpoint-mean counterexample remains a duty even though the briefs are short. A graph estimate is resolution-limited; differentiation rules are not introduced as a new learner requirement.

ownFreshIndependentTransferAndCounterexa.task: For s(t)=t³−3t on[0,2] compare average velocity, local velocity at1, and mean endpoint velocities. Independently compare uniform s=t with a pause followed by s=2(t−1)² aftert=1.
ownFreshIndependentTransferAndCounterexa.solution: The cubic has average1m/s, local rate0att=1, and endpoint-speed mean3m/s; s(1)=−2m is a position, not velocity. Symmetric secants about1 have slopeh²→0. Uniform and pause/ramp motions both travel0→2m in2s, average1m/s, but the second has local velocities0at0.5s and2m/sat1.5s.
ownFreshIndependentTransferAndCounterexa.counterexample: A zero instantaneous velocity need not mean a pause over an interval. Equal averages do not fix local motion. Analytic formulas are reviewer checks; the target learner may obtain the slopes geometrically.

bilingualCoverageRationale.de: Das ganze Profil fordert Definitionen mit Winkel-, Weg- und Zeiteinheiten, die Herleitung aus s=rφ, tangentiale Richtung, Radiusvergleich und einen frischen Zeit-/Umlauftransfer. Beide Zahlenbriefs stimmen einschließlich1,6πrad/s sowieπ→π/2m/s bei verdoppelter Trommelperiode. Bogenmaß ist eine geometrische Voraussetzung der Relation, nicht nur ein blind einzusetzender Faktor.
bilingualCoverageRationale.en: The full profile requires definitions with angle/distance/time units, derivation from s=rφ, tangential direction, radius comparison and period transfer. The two literal numerical cases are correct. Radian measure is part of understanding the relation rather than an unexplained conversion constant.

ownFreshIndependentTransferAndCounterexa.task: Use a rigid disc at1.25rev/s with radii0.08/0.24m. Then a directed rotation−450° in0.5s at radius0.04m; explain why reducing the angle to a coterminal270° before division is wrong.
ownFreshIndependentTransferAndCounterexa.solution: Both disc points haveω=2.5πrad/s and speeds0.2π/0.6πm/s. The second rotation has directedΔφ=−5π/2rad, angular velocity−5πrad/s and directed tangential velocity−0.2πm/s; speed is0.2πm/s with clockwise direction. Coterminal rays preserve final position, not elapsed total rotation.
ownFreshIndependentTransferAndCounterexa.counterexample: Same angular speed does not imply same tangential speed at different radii. A coterminal terminal ray cannot replace the total angular displacement inω=Δφ/Δt.

bilingualCoverageRationale.de: Das komplette P ist fachlich korrekt und eng auf ideale einzelne C-/L-Bauteile bei passiver Vorzeichenkonvention begrenzt. Beide Differentialbeziehungen, Zeiger, Amplitudenverhältnisse, Einheiten und Frequenztransfers werden verlangt. Die beiden Literalbriefs ergeben20mA/40mA sowie1V/5mA; die Unterscheidung passiver Klemmenspannung und entgegengesetzt orientierter induzierter EMK verhindert einen Vorzeichenfehlschluss.
bilingualCoverageRationale.en: The complete profile is correct for ideal individual C/L components under the passive convention. It requires both differential laws, phasors, amplitude ratios, units and changed-frequency transfer. The literal cases yield20/40mA and1V/5mA. The explicit terminal-voltage/emf distinction prevents a sign error.

ownFreshIndependentTransferAndCounterexa.task: Take C=4.7µF and u=3cos[2000(t−0.001)]+1V; triple frequency at equal AC voltage amplitude. Independently use L=0.15H and i=0.012cos[400(t−0.002)]A, then double frequency at equal voltage amplitude.
ownFreshIndependentTransferAndCounterexa.solution: For C,i=−0.0282sin[2000(t−0.001)]A, equivalent to a current cosine leading voltage byπ/2; amplitude becomes84.6mA after triplingω. The1Voffset differentiates to0. For L,u=−0.72sin[400(t−0.002)]V, a voltage cosine leading current byπ/2. At fixed0.72V and doubledω,current amplitude becomes6mA. F·V/s=A and H·A/s=V.
ownFreshIndependentTransferAndCounterexa.counterexample: Missing the inner factorω gives a wrong amplitude; increasing frequency does not increase current for both component types at fixed voltage. Theω=0boundary is not a finite-frequency AC case and does not justify division byω.
